text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Daiwa Scarlet gazes pensively off into the distance.

text_block_list.name: Daiwa Scarlet
text_block_list.text: Eek?! What the heck! Don't startle me like that!

text_block_list.name: Daiwa Scarlet
text_block_list.text: S-So it's time to train already, is it? Hmph, no problem! I'm ready whenever!

text_block_list.name: Daiwa Scarlet
text_block_list.text: All right, maybe I misspoke!

text_block_list.name: Daiwa Scarlet
text_block_list.text: What I meant was, I thought we were going to watch a race today!

text_block_list.name: Daiwa Scarlet
text_block_list.text: Where did that remote get to? Ugh, fine. I'll just do it by hand…

text_block_list.name: TV
text_block_list.text: All eyes are on the talented athletes in this year's Japanese Derby…

text_block_list.name: Daiwa Scarlet
text_block_list.text: …Oh.

text_block_list.name: TV
text_block_list.text: Blip.

text_block_list.name: Daiwa Scarlet
text_block_list.text: I just don't get it.

text_block_list.name: Daiwa Scarlet
text_block_list.text: What does she even mean by "cool"? If that's her goal, she could at least be consistent.

text_block_list.name: Daiwa Scarlet
text_block_list.text: She entered the Oka Sho, then totally reversed course and changed tours. She quit like a coward midway! Is that supposed to be cool? It seems pretty lame to me!

text_block_list.name: Daiwa Scarlet
text_block_list.text: And yet…
choice_data_list: Why did she enter the Derby?

text_block_list.name: Daiwa Scarlet
text_block_list.text: That's what I'd like to know! I don't have a clue!
choice_data_list: Then how about we ask her ourselves?

text_block_list.name: Daiwa Scarlet
text_block_list.text: …Pardon?

text_block_list.name: Daiwa Scarlet
text_block_list.text: N-Now, just hold on there, Trainer. Where do you think you're going?

text_block_list.name: Crowd
text_block_list.text: Wooooo!

text_block_list.name: Spectator A
text_block_list.text: It's been a long time since I've seen someone switch tours. Years, at least…

text_block_list.name: Spectator B
text_block_list.text: I really wanted to see Vodka take the usual tour route and run the Japanese Oaks, like Scarlet. She really could have taken the Queen's throne…

text_block_list.name: Spectator A
text_block_list.text: Nah, that would've been too cliche. This is way more interesting.

text_block_list.name: Spectator B
text_block_list.text: Not to me. It just feels like she ran away from the Tiara.

text_block_list.name: Daiwa Scarlet
text_block_list.text: It seems like not everybody's happy with what she's done.

text_block_list.name: Caster
text_block_list.text: The leading pack has passed the big tree and they're onto the final stretch! Who'll push ahead for the lead?!

text_block_list.name: Caster
text_block_list.text: And it's Vodka! Vodka's broken through the pack… but she looks like she's struggling! She can't quite overtake the front!

text_block_list.name: Spectator B
text_block_list.text: See, what did I tell you? She should have gone for the Japanese Oaks, not the Derby.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Skeptical murmurs rise from the crowd, but Vodka keeps on running.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: With her head held high and her eyes focused forward, she brushes off their concerns, never straying from her path.

text_block_list.name: Daiwa Scarlet
text_block_list.text: What the heck?

text_block_list.name: Daiwa Scarlet
text_block_list.text: What are you doing?! Are you really going to lose now?!

text_block_list.name: Daiwa Scarlet
text_block_list.text: Show them why you're here! Pull yourself together and run like I know you can!

text_block_list.name: Daiwa Scarlet
text_block_list.text: Show them you weren't just running away from me!

text_block_list.name: Caster
text_block_list.text: Hold on… Vodka's making a break for it! She's done it! She's used her sprinting skills to break through!

text_block_list.name: Caster
text_block_list.text: The winner of the Japanese Derby is Vodka! She powered past the others and made it to the finish line!

text_block_list.name: Crowd
text_block_list.text: Wooooo!

text_block_list.name: Spectator A
text_block_list.text: See! Wasn't she amazing?!

text_block_list.name: Spectator B
text_block_list.text: You're right. My heart was racing! She was the coolest!

text_block_list.name: Spectator B
text_block_list.text: I'll never forget this race for the rest of my life!

text_block_list.name: Daiwa Scarlet
text_block_list.text: A race… the crowds will never forget…

text_block_list.name: Daiwa Scarlet
text_block_list.text: Nothing.

text_block_list.name: Daiwa Scarlet
text_block_list.text: Vodka ran the Derby. That's all. Nothing more, nothing less.

text_block_list.name: Daiwa Scarlet
text_block_list.text: But… why can't I get it out of my head?

text_block_list.name: Daiwa Scarlet
text_block_list.text: Why can't I forget the moment she became number one?

text_block_list.name: Daiwa Scarlet
text_block_list.text: Cool? What does that even mean?

text_block_list.name: Daiwa Scarlet
text_block_list.text: It's just some nonsense she keeps spouting. It doesn't mean anything tangible… So, why…

text_block_list.name: Daiwa Scarlet
text_block_list.text: Trainer, I can't stand this! I need to beat her!

text_block_list.name: Daiwa Scarlet
text_block_list.text: She took away my "number one" title. I need to take it back!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: A brilliant flame burns in Daiwa Scarlet's eyes.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: She's still not really able to see where this quest for "number one" will take her, but…

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: I think we've found a big clue. Next up is the Shuka Sho, the last race of the Triple Tiara.
